title: Transfer berhasil
text: Rp8.127 udah dikirim ke BCA NAMA PENERIMA.
notes: The outgoing half of a GoPay -> BCA transfer. Its pair is bca/2026-08-06-pemasukan-transfer, 2.6s later.
Recipient name redacted; the original read 'BCA <full name>'. The 'BCA ' prefix is GoPay's, not part of the name.
Amount shape: 'Rp' with no space, dot thousands, no decimals.
On its own this looks like KELUAR from GoPay. Only the matcher can promote it to PINDAH_DOMPET.
